summary: Job 1421 passed the active-learning entry review. Six exact pre/fail structures from images 04-06 now have a hash-bound MatRIS/AQCat25 prediction request and compatible SIGMA=0.20 eV VASP NSW=0 static-label inputs; all local diagnostic-static preflights pass and no job was submitted.

payload.objective: Obtain user review and separate authorization for the six-structure MZ73 dual-model prediction batch. Review returned predictions before any VASP label submission.
current_evidence: The hash-bound step-0 seed snapshot is converged and geometry-valid, retains O-H transition-region images 04, 05, and 06, and is the last persisted valid full-path reference; the immediate pre-failure step was not separately retained.
The step-157 restart preserves all eight failed structures. Exact pre/fail pairs were prepared for images 04, 05, and 06 without structure or rounded-geometry duplicates.
The six structures do not overlap the frozen seven-structure held-out TS validation set by exact structure hash or translation-invariant geometry hash.
A six-structure frozen-checkpoint MatRIS/AQCat25 exact-structure prediction request validates locally and remains prepared but unsubmitted.

Six exact-structure VASP static force-label directories use GGA=PE, ENCUT=400 eV, ISPIN=2, ISMEAR=1, SIGMA=0.20 eV, Gamma 5x5x1, NSW=0, IBRION=-1, ISYM=0, LDIPOL=false, the fixed bottom-18 mask, and 32 ranks.
All six repository diagnostic_static preflights pass. The VASP batch is prepared but cannot be submitted before the exact dual-model prediction set returns and is reviewed.
No GPU, VASP, fine-tuning, path-rerun, micro-NEB, or Dimer job was submitted.
Durable preference UP-039 now requires both active-learning and direct-VASP choices after GPU TS failures and makes active-learning diagnosis the preferred first route when its entry gate passes.
payload.one_executable_step: Present the six-structure package for review; after separate explicit authorization, submit only the bound MatRIS/AQCat25 prediction batch to MZ73.
payload.submission_boundary: Preparation is not submission authority. VASP labels require returned/reviewed exact predictions and separate bounded authorization; fine-tuning, checkpoint promotion, path rerun, micro-NEB, and Dimer remain separately unauthorized.
done_when: The user accepts or requests changes to the six pre/fail structures.
Any authorized MZ73 prediction execution is bound to the prepared request hash and passes its remote no-model preflight.
